title: Things You Should Definitely Ghost
trend: TikTok + Instagram Reels Halloween 'Things You Should Definitely Ghost' (a costumed ghost in a white sheet and sunglasses holds up signs naming habits to dismiss) combined with the 'Ghost Photoshoot' sheet-and-sunglasses group photo format (New Engen 2026 Halloween TikTok & Reels trends list; peak the final week before Halloween). Tre shoots a park ghost photoshoot for his friends; the tall ghost holding signs about pigeons turns out to be Douglas, a stranger who was napping on the bench under a sheet, while the real Mike is at the wrong park in someone else's family photo
length_reason: Ghost sign and photoshoot posts are quick one-clip videos or carousels that run well under a minute, so it stays at the low end (3:00), which also fits Instagram's Reels limit.
youtube_title: Things you should definitely ghost (our group ghost photoshoot went wrong) 👻
description:
Tre sets up a ghost photoshoot in the park. Lacey has signs about him, the tall ghost has signs about pigeons, and the bunny wants everybody off her bush. Then Mike calls.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #halloween
tiktok_caption: things you should definitely ghost, group photoshoot edition 👻 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #halloween

lines.text: Okay, ghost photoshoot. Sheets on, sunglasses on, hold up your signs.
Things you should definitely ghost. Number one. People who say we should hang out, and never hang out.
Love it. Very spooky. Very true.
Number one. Pigeons.
Just pigeons?
All of them. They know what they did.
Excuse me. You are standing on my bush.
Sorry, who said that?
The bunny. In the bush. Which is my house. Which you are sitting on.
Oh my gosh, she's so cute. Can she be in the photo?
I charge by the ear.
Fine. Next sign. Lacey, go.
Number two. People who reply with just the letter k.
Who even does that?
You. Every time. I sent you a birthday cake picture. You said k.
It was a nice k. It had feelings.
Number two. The hot dog man by the fountain.
Mike, what did the hot dog man do?
He said, have a nice day. He did not mean it.
Also, Mike, since when are you British?
Since the sheet. It is an old sheet. It has been abroad.
I have lived here nine years. That is not Mike's walk.
Mike walks like that when he's hungry.
Mike walks like a shopping cart. This one glides.
Okay, number three. And this one is personal.
Uh oh.
Photographers who charge their own friends twenty dollars.
That's the friends and family rate. Strangers pay twenty five.
Photographers who say one more, forty times.
Art takes forty tries. Sometimes fifty.
Number three. Photographers in hats indoors.
We're outside, Mike.
In my heart, it is indoors.
Number four. Teenagers who feed the ducks bread. The ducks are on a diet.
Okay, why does everybody have a sign but the bunny is just yelling?
I have a sign. It is the bush. It says keep off. You are on it.
Okay, okay. Big group photo. Everybody lean in.
Wait. Tre. Your phone keeps buzzing.
It's Mike.
Mike is right here.
Mike says, where are you guys, I'm at Riverside Park in my sheet.
He says a family just took him in. They gave him a juice box.
Then who is that?
Hello. I am Douglas.
I was napping on that bench under my sheet. You said, smile. So I smiled.
You've been doing the signs for ten minutes!
You handed me a marker. I have a lot of feelings about pigeons.
I said it was not Mike. Nobody listens to the bunny.
Mike just sent their photo. He's holding a sign.
It says, things you should definitely ghost. My old friends.
He's in their family photo now?
And I am in yours. It is an exchange program.
Fine. Douglas, you're in. Twenty dollars.
Strangers pay twenty five. I heard you.
Everybody say boo.
Boo!
Things you should definitely ghost. This park. I'm moving to Riverside.
